## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: traffic signs and pavement markings
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The selected range includes sign sample galleries whose images carry little extracted text; only printed captions and paragraphs were turned into facts, and the pictures were not described beyond them [A04].
The gallery page after the regulatory samples repeats the DO NOT STOP ON TRACKS caption and adds only a heading, so it contributed no new fact.
Railroad crossing rules were taught in the railroad section; here only the sign shapes, colors and the look-twice habit printed in this chapter are stated [A02].
The example Emergency Notification sign shows placeholder digits; no number from the image was used [A03].
School zone speed reductions are mentioned without amounts or hours, so none are stated here [A03].

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
